name: MiniMax H3 Image (Official)
description: Official Draw Things preset for MiniMax H3 Image (16MP image model)
notes: PREVIEW / NOT YET SUPPORTED: MiniMax H3 Image (16MP image model). 16MP at every aspect ratio from 4096x4096 to 6272x2688 without an upscaler. Distilled to 6 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, shift 3, resolution-dependent shift disabled. kontext edit model: up to 16 reference images via moodboard, identified in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc. Expects a detailed English description of the whole image. Kept as a reference recipe; servers/clients do not support this model yet.
